arxiv.summaryZh: 逐题把正确答案的置信度推向1、错误答案推向0的奖励在实践中不可达，且被压到极端的置信度无法反映问题之间的相对难易，导致选择性预测在非零风险容忍度下几乎失效。CARE 在一组问答上按多个风险容忍度由全体置信度导出弃答阈值，并奖励落在阈值正确一侧的置信度，使每条口头置信度相对其他问题而非仅相对自身对错标签被强化。数学任务上，5% 风险下的覆盖率(C@5)在 MATH-500、GSM8K、Big-Math-Digits 上由 0.8% 提升到 42.4%;在 HotpotQA 多跳问答上训练后，跨分布泛化到 CommonsenseQA、GPQA、SimpleQA、TriviaQA 等基准，C@5 从 12.3% 提升到 23.6%。该机制适用于需要按风险预算弃答或转交人工的 LLM 部署场景。
arxiv.reason: 后训练RL做置信度估计与弃答，方法新颖且结果扎实

arxiv.title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
arxiv.abstract: Parametric memory allows Large Language Models to internalize knowledge directly into their weights, offering a potentially powerful alternative to retrieval-based memory (RAG). However, existing approaches to parametric memory are difficult to deploy as they largely mirror the Continual Learning (CL) objective of retaining information indefinitely. This is neither sustainable nor sufficient for a memory system, which must govern knowledge across its lifecycle by retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and allowing transient information to fade. We propose a system for parametric memory management consisting of a memory substrate (handling information storage and forgetting) and a learned policy (what to remember, how deeply, and for how long). Our substrate is a fixed-capacity LoRA adapter that consists of k-hot rank combinations which store facts without catastrophic interference and maintain an independently controlled temporal decay, enabling outdated information to fade while long-term facts persist. On this substrate, we train a lightweight controller that governs each incoming user event to ensure the memory system reflects the user's true, updated belief state. To evaluate how memory systems manage user memory, we introduce a controlled dataset of long-horizon user trajectories with varying persistence of facts based on changing belief states and user-behavioral shifts, and probe queries that test recall while information is valid and abstention after it expires. Our policy learns to effectively manage user memory over its entire lifecycle, balancing recall and abstention to achieve 86% of oracle performance, unlike CL and RAG baselines that primarily default to one of the two behaviors. By providing the first system to manage memory directly in model weights, this work establishes a foundation for long-horizon parametric memory.
arxiv.titleZh: 有些记忆必须淡去：模型参数中用户记忆的持久性与衰减
arxiv.summaryZh: 参数化记忆把知识直接写入模型权重，是RAG之外的一条路径，但现有做法沿用持续学习目标、只求无限期保留，无法管理记忆生命周期。该工作提出由固定容量LoRA子strate(k-hot秩组合，可无灾难性干扰地存储事实并独立控制时间衰减)与轻量控制器(决定每条用户事件是否记住、记多深、记多久)组成的参数化记忆管理系统。同时构建长程用户轨迹数据集，覆盖信念变化与行为漂移，评测信息有效期内召回与过期后弃答。控制器达到oracle性能的86%，而CL与RAG基线通常只偏向召回或弃答其中之一。
arxiv.reason: 参数化记忆生命周期管理，命中Agent记忆与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Steering Automated Scientific Discovery via Audited Epistemic Exploration
arxiv.abstract: Scientific discovery requires revisiting the hypotheses in light of new evidence and identifying promising directions beyond those already explored. However, research agents often make claims that are not supported by their observations, explore a narrow hypothesis space, and retain beliefs despite recognizing conflicting evidence. These failures motivate the search for an explicit epistemic state that captures both beliefs about existing hypotheses and directions for further exploration. To this end, we propose Epistemic Compass (EpiCompass), a plug-and-play scaffold that maintains this state through an epistemic tree linking hypotheses, evidence, beliefs, and revisions. As an investigation progresses, EpiCompass reassesses the hypotheses explored against accumulated evidence and uses unresolved conflicts and unexplored directions to guide hypothesis generation. It selects candidates by anticipated epistemic gain, accounting for both refinement of existing hypotheses and expansion of the hypothesis space, and verifies the final conclusion against the accumulated evidence. Experimental results across three scientific discovery benchmarks and three LLM backbones demonstrate that EpiCompass consistently outperforms baselines, with further analyses showing reductions in errors of unsupported claims and failures to revise beliefs.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过可审计的认知探索引导自动化科学发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究型 Agent 常出现结论缺乏观测支撑、假设空间探索过窄、面对冲突证据仍固守旧信念的问题。EpiCompass 是一个即插即用的 scaffold，用连接假设、证据、信念与修订的认知树显式维护认知状态，随探索推进重新评估已探索假设，并以未解决的冲突与未探索方向引导新假设生成；候选按预期认知增益选择，兼顾已有假设的细化与假设空间的扩展，最终结论需与累积证据核对。在三个科学发现 benchmark、三个 LLM backbone 上均稳定优于基线，且无支撑论断与信念不修订两类错误明显下降。
arxiv.reason: 科研智能体 scaffold 与认知状态建模，命中 Agent 与 AI for Research

arxiv.title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
arxiv.abstract: Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate datasets, and port frameworks. However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated. To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size. CCI strongly predicts average solve rates across eight public coding benchmarks ($R^2 = 0.951$), identifying patch size and complexity as top predictors. Guided by CCI, we develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework where agents inject controlled mutations into working ML repositories, synthesizing over 6,600 bug-injected MLE repository variants and nearly 260K lines of injected code based on 222 source repositories. Using BuggyMLE, we make two contributions. First, we construct BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite, the first difficulty-graded, repository-level variant of MLE-Bench Lite; across 14 evaluated models, the top solve rate drops from 95% to 9% as difficulty is scaled from the easiest to the hardest tier. Second, we synthesize a training curriculum across three difficulty levels over 200 additional ML repositories, fine-tuning a Qwen3.5-9B model to rival frontier models on BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite. Our trained model transfers beyond ML, raising its SWE-bench Lite resolve rate from 24% to 33% and its LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 from 69% to 71%.
arxiv.titleZh: BuggyMLE:通过注入 bug 扩展机器学习工程难度
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 MLE 基准只允许单文件编辑，缺少完整仓库与 shell 权限，而仓库级软件工程基准又已趋于饱和。为此提出 Code Complexity Index（CCI），用仓库规模、依赖深度、补丁大小等十项结构特征刻画难度，在八个公开编程基准上以 R²=0.951 预测平均解决率；据此构建 BuggyMLE，向 222 个可用 ML 仓库注入受控 bug，合成 6600 余个变体、约 26 万行注入代码。基于该框架发布首个难度分级的仓库级 MLE-Bench Lite 变体，14 个模型中最高解决率随难度从 95% 降到 9%；并用三级难度课程微调 Qwen3.5-9B，其 SWE-bench Lite 解决率从 24% 升至 33%、LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 从 69% 升至 71%，显示跨任务迁移。
arxiv.reason: 仓库级 MLE 基准加难度度量与课程训练，切中代码智能与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. The loop consists of three steps: (1) User-driven evaluation lets simulated users raise their requirements as issues while they work with the harness over multiple turns. (2) Team-based modification implements those requirements as generalizable changes rather than task-specific patches. (3) Requirement-driven selection merges a change only when it resolves a verified requirement and passes review. Empirically, on held-out tasks, AHE-Beta raises pass@1 from 21.9% to 33.3% while using 40.8% fewer tokens than Base Harness, and achieves higher pass@1 than Claude Code, Meta-Harness, and AHE. In a blind human A/B test, real users prefer AHE-Beta in 31 of 48 valid pairs and rate it higher on all five dimensions, matching the directional preference of the user simulator. The human A/B results show that AHE-Beta achieves its goal of aligning harness evolution with real-world user requirements. Without further evolution, the gains transfer to GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with pass@1 improvements of 15.8% and 5.3% over Base Harness. Together, these results show that requirement-centered harness evolution is a more general method for improving agent capabilities.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta:以需求为中心的智能体外壳演进
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有外壳演进方法忽视隐性需求与交互需求、且依赖单一演进智能体打补丁和用基准分数选改从而陷入基准特定局部最优的问题，提出以需求为中心的演进闭环:模拟用户在多轮使用中把需求提成 issue，由团队式修改将需求实现为可泛化的改动，仅在改动解决已验证需求并通过评审时才合并。在留出任务上，pass@1 从 21.9% 提升到 33.3%,token 用量比 Base Harness 少 40.8%，并高于 Claude Code、Meta-Harness 与 AHE;48 组盲测人工 A/B 中用户 31 次偏好 AHE-Beta，五个维度评分均更高。未经额外演进，增益可迁移到 GLM-5.3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,pass@1 分别再提升 15.8% 与 5.3%。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 自动演进，命中 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
arxiv.abstract: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation suite that combines utility of user simulators for evaluating agents and two measures of fidelity to real users: population-level fidelity assesses collective interaction patterns, while trace-level fidelity assesses the preservation of individual users' goals, constraints, and persona. Under the same detection criterion, our evaluation suite detects all 10 perturbations. Evaluating six user simulators on 351 real multi-turn sessions in which 348 distinct users across 23 languages and agents work together to create and refine artifacts such as full-stack web apps, games, design assets, and automated workflows, we find that population-level measures can miss when a simulated user pursues the wrong goal, ignores a constraint, or behaves out of character, highlighting the need to assess fidelity at comprehensive granularities.
arxiv.titleZh: 论交互式 Agent 的用户模拟器评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 交互式 Agent 的评测依赖用户模拟器，但模拟器自身的评测是否可靠尚不清楚。该工作对既有指标做元评测:扰动模拟回放，注入目标改变、约束遗漏、过早终止、接受劣质产物等10类失败，检验指标能否识别。三项先前方法仅检出5–6类，合并得分甚至偏好被要求接受劣质产物的模拟人群。为此提出的评测套件结合模拟器效用与群体级、轨迹级两层保真度，在同一标准下检出全部10类;在23种语言、348名真实用户的351段多轮会话上评测六个模拟器，显示群体级指标会漏掉目标错误、忽略约束与人格走样。
arxiv.reason: Agent 用户模拟器评测的方法学工作，直接命中评测方向

arxiv.title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
arxiv.abstract: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
arxiv.titleZh: 通用进步可替代语言模型中的特定训练数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究训练数据被过滤或扣留后，能力被延迟多久、重新习得又需要多少数据。在象棋、黑白棋、分子字符串、括号语言与网页文本中分别扣留单项技能的训练信号，发现模型在其余数据上的通用进步可替代被扣留的数据:大模型的能力延迟可由小模型预测;重新加入被扣留数据后，只需从零训练所需数据的一小部分即可掌握该技能，且这一比例随模型变强而下降;同等难度的对照规则学习明显更慢;7B 参数模型中被剔除的编程语言同样如此。数据过滤只是延迟而非消除能力，对预训练数据配比与安全过滤策略有直接含义。
arxiv.reason: 预训练数据过滤与能力习得机制，实验系统且覆盖7B模型

arxiv.title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
arxiv.titleZh: On-Policy 变形为混合注意力模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 把预训练 Transformer 转成混合注意力模型时，需在给定预算下确定哪些层保留全注意力。该工作指出 FlashMorph 的层选择存在两处 off-policy 偏差:连续分支插值与 teacher-forcing 隐状态同离散混合计算不一致;冻结权重也忽略了后续恢复阶段的参数适配。为此提出 FlashMorph2，用采样出的离散混合架构以自身隐状态端到端评估，并在恢复目标下联合优化层选择分数与模型权重。在 Qwen3 各规模与多种线性注意力变体上，其 RULER 平均分比 FlashMorph 高 2.42、LongBench 高 1.08、召回密集型任务高 0.76，层选择仅耗 0.72--3.57 GPU 小时(0.6B--8B)。
arxiv.reason: 混合注意力层选择，直击架构改造与效率，数据扎实

arxiv.title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
arxiv.abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.
arxiv.comment: 41 pages. Ancillary files: a public sample of 48 development instances with scripted-oracle episodes. Hosted evaluation: https://eval.openhagen.ai
arxiv.titleZh: Openhagen Worlds:用于测量与训练科学发现智能体的校准环境
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对科学发现智能体评测难以区分「设计实验并从结果推理」与记忆、隐含评分规则或捷径策略的问题，构建了包含 27 个程序生成环境的 Openhagen Worlds，智能体需在预算内做实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器对照隐藏真值判定。每个难度关卡都经过校准:脚本化 oracle 在 64 个开发实例上成功率至少 0.75，最强非演绎策略至多 0.25，各捷径策略至多 0.35，共 178 个难度层级。在 84 个留出的前沿实例上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 默认推理开销解出 32 个，最大开销(单次调用最多 393,216 tokens)解出 57 个，oracle 为 79;on-policy 专家迭代把 9B 模型在训练族核心层级的成功率从 0.090 提升到 0.148。
arxiv.reason: 科学发现 Agent 环境与校准评测，直接命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 深度先于广度：面向 LLM Agent 的反向到正向课程与优势分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程 LLM Agent 训练中稀疏终端奖励导致的信用分配与探索困难，以策略诱导的能力区域为视角，把长程任务拆成「先到达更易求解的状态」与「从该状态完成任务」两个耦合子问题：用配对优势为两个子目标提供独立信号，并用渐进式反向到正向课程，先沿成功参考轨迹向后退扩展能力区域，再经 on-policy 探索扩展到参考轨迹之外的状态。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 成功率分别达 90.1%/96.1% 与 80.2%/82.6%，优于同类 agentic RL 方法。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 的课程学习与优势分解，方法新颖、结果扎实

arxiv.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
arxiv.abstract: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
arxiv.titleZh: CurvDelta：面向精准学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决 LLM 适配中的能力保持问题：适配达成目标的同时可能损害通用能力。CurvDelta 把保持约束写进参数化本身，通过分析保持损失在适配前模型附近的局部几何，构造出一个参数更新几乎不改变保持损失的低曲率空间，并用 K-FAC 与因子化投影让该构造对 LLM 可行，同时给出低秩变体 CurvLoRA。在数学推理、代码生成与知识遗忘（TOFU、MUSE）上，下游性能与基线相当而通用能力保持更好，遗忘任务上保持性能接近从头重训参考。
arxiv.reason: 保持约束参数化的适配与遗忘方法，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
